name.value: Canadas Best Value Inn - Prince George

description.value: Canada's Best Value Inn Prince George is a budget motel situated along Highway 97, now operating under the Sonesta hotel umbrella following the Red Lion brand transition. It positions itself as a base for outdoor pursuits including mountain biking, hiking, skiing at nearby Tabor Mountain, and fishing in the Northern Capital of BC. An on-site restaurant, Daddyo's Pizza and Ribs, provides breakfast through dinner for guests who need a solid meal after a long day on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record: address, phone number, and operating status are all confirmed. The site explicitly lists hotel features including 'Vending/Ice Machines' and 'WiFi Internet in all guest rooms and public areas,' and confirms an on-site restaurant (Daddyo's Pizza and Ribs) serving breakfast through dinner. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site; the listed 'Outdoor Plug-In' feature almost certainly refers to vehicle block heaters standard in cold Northern BC winters, not e-bike charging, so it is not counted.
concerns: The website domain is redlion.com but the property now operates under Sonesta International Hotels Corporation (footer: '© 2026 Sonesta International Hotels Corporation'). The OSM URL resolves correctly so no directory action is needed, but the brand transition is noted.
'Outdoor Plug-In' listed as a hotel feature almost certainly refers to vehicle block heaters standard in cold Northern BC winters, not e-bike charging — not counted without explicit confirmation.
